title: Hub Studio Routes Auth and Presence Schema
description:
Rework the hub server (framework/product/os/hub/rs/bin.rs) from single-studio, share-token-only routing to real multi-studio routing with authenticated sessions:

1. Studio-scoped routes: change flat /documents/{id}/... routes to /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}[/envelope|/ops|/share|/ws] plus /studios/{studio_id}/nodes. Rekey HubState's actor map by (studio_id, document_id) tuple. Delete DEFAULT_STUDIO_ID and thread real studio_id path params through every handler.

2. Auth wiring: rewrite authorized() to first try resolving the bearer token as an AuthSessionRecord via get_auth_session -> get_role, falling back to authorized_by_token (existing share-token path) if session resolution fails. In handle_ws, populate PresencePeer.user_id/role from the resolved session instead of hardcoded None. Add a minimal POST /auth/sessions dev-mode route (accepts an email, upserts a user via create_user, returns a session token) - explicitly not real SSO/OAuth. Share-token flow remains the anonymous-viewer path, unchanged.

3. Blob routes (conditional on sibling ticket 0D having landed put_blob/get_blob/has_blob on HubStorage trait in framework/product/os/hub/storage/rs/lib.rs): if present, add GET|PUT|HEAD /studios/{studio_id}/blobs/{hash} routes gated by the same auth. If absent, skip and note deferred in the close summary.

4. Presence schema extension: in framework/core/rs/lib.rs, extend PresencePeer with optional cursor: Option<PresencePoint> {x,y}, viewport: Option<PresenceViewport> {x,y,zoom}, drag_ghost_json: Option<String>, all #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")].

5. Mirror studio_id into PersistenceBinding::Hub in framework/sync/rs/lib.rs, framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts, and the hub-connect URL builder in framework/product/os/core/js/backbone-worker.ts. Hand-fix every call site constructing PersistenceBinding::Hub / {kind:"hub",...} repo-wide (breaking greenfield change, no compat shim).

6. Fixtures: hand-fix framework/sync/fixtures/*.json referencing the old flat hub URL shape or missing studio_id.

Verify with cargo check --workspace, cargo test -p <hub pkg>, cargo test -p semio-framework-sync, cargo test -p semio-framework-core, and bun vitest for framework/product/os/core/js. Extend existing hub test region (grep ws_duplex_fan_out) rather than adding new test files.
summary:
Reworked the hub server from single-studio/share-token-only to real multi-studio routing with authenticated sessions.

**1. Studio-scoped routes** (framework/product/os/hub/rs/bin.rs): routes are now `/studios/{studio_id}/nodes`, `/studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}[/envelope|/ops|/share|/ws]`, plus `POST /auth/sessions`. `HubState.actors` is now `DashMap<(String, String), DocumentHandle>` keyed by `(studio_id, document_id)` — same document id in two studios now gets fully independent actors (own mailbox/presence/broadcast). `DEFAULT_STUDIO_ID` constant deleted; `DocumentActor::load` takes a real `studio_id` and threads it into `ensure_document`.

**2. Auth wiring**: `resolve_auth()` first resolves the bearer as an `AuthSessionRecord` (via `get_auth_session` → expiry check → `get_role(studio_id, user_id)`), falling back to the existing `authorized_by_token` share-token path if session resolution fails; `authorized()` wraps it as a bool for REST handlers. `handle_ws` now populates `PresencePeer.user_id`/`role` from the resolved session (None/None for the anonymous share-token path, unchanged). Added `POST /auth/sessions` (dev-mode: email → upsert user via `create_user` → `create_auth_session`, returns `{token, user_id}`; explicitly not real SSO/OAuth, documented in a docstring).

**3. Blob routes**: skipped — `put_blob`/`get_blob`/`has_blob` are not present on `HubStorage` in framework/product/os/hub/storage/rs/lib.rs (confirmed via grep), so ticket 0D (content-addressed blob store) has not landed yet. Noted for a follow-up ticket.

**4. Presence schema** (framework/core/rs/lib.rs, 🔖HubProtocol region): added `PresencePoint {x, y}`, `PresenceViewport {x, y, zoom}`, and extended `PresencePeer` with `cursor: Option<PresencePoint>`, `viewport: Option<PresenceViewport>`, `drag_ghost_json: Option<String>`, all `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`. Re-exported both new structs at the crate root alongside `PresencePeer`. (Note: `user_id`/`role` fields already existed on `PresencePeer` from prior work — only the three new fields were added here.)

**5. `studio_id` mirrored into `PersistenceBinding::Hub`**: added to the Rust variant (framework/sync/rs/lib.rs), the TS type (framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts), and threaded through `hub_ws_url()` (now takes studio_id), both native and wasm actor structs/constructors, `backbone-worker.ts`'s `connectHub` (WS URL is now `/studios/{studioId}/documents/{id}/ws`), and the remote-uri helpers `parseRemoteBackboneUri`/`buildRemoteBackboneUri` (now 3-segment: `remote://host:port/studioId/documentId`). Hand-fixed every call site repo-wide: framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's `hub_binding()`, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs's `parse_persistence_binding` (native shell uri parsing, `remote://host:port[/studio_id]`, defaults to `"default"`), framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx's `attachSyncBackbone` action handler and `SyncAttachCard.attachFromDraft`, and all `PersistenceBinding::Hub` literals in framework/sync/rs/lib.rs's test suite.

**6. Fixtures**: reviewed framework/sync/fixtures/*.json (basic-remote-ops, remote-ops-backlog, snapshot-replaced) — all three are folder-only actor test vectors with no hub URL shape or studio_id field, so nothing required hand-fixing.

**Also fixed in passing**: a `PresencePeer` struct literal in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's test module was missing the three new fields (would not have compiled).

**New route table**: `POST /auth/sessions`; `GET|POST /studios/{studio_id}/nodes`; `GET /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}`; `GET|PUT /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}/envelope`; `POST|GET /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}/ops`; `POST /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}/share`; `GET /studios/{studio_id}/documents/{id}/ws`.

**New `PresencePeer` fields**: `cursor: Option<PresencePoint{x,y}>`, `viewport: Option<PresenceViewport{x,y,zoom}>`, `drag_ghost_json: Option<String>` (plus pre-existing `user_id`/`role`).

**New `PersistenceBinding::Hub` shape**: `{ base_url: String, studio_id: String, token: Option<String> }` (Rust) / `{ kind: "hub", baseUrl, studioId, token? }` (TS).

**Verification**: extended the existing hub test region (grep `ws_duplex_fan_out`) rather than adding new test files — updated all existing tests to the new studio-scoped signatures, plus added `studio_scoped_actors_are_isolated` (proves the DashMap rekey actually isolates per-studio actor state) and `auth_session_grants_role_and_bypasses_share_gate` (proves the new session-auth path resolves role and grants access a share-token gate would otherwise deny). `bun nx test @semio-tech/framework-os-core` passed cleanly (28/28), including updated `parseRemoteBackboneUri`/`buildRemoteBackboneUri` tests for the new 3-segment uri shape.

**Blocked**: `cargo check -p os-hub` (and therefore `cargo test -p os-hub`/`-p semio-framework-sync`/`-p semio-framework-core`) could not be completed — every attempt (5 retries over ~25+ minutes, including an isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` build to rule out lock contention from the ~50 concurrent cargo processes other sessions were running) failed with the same pre-existing, unrelated parse error in `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` lines 12380-12387 (`error[E0753]: expected outer doc comment`, inner `//!` used mid-function instead of `//`/`///`). `ui_wgpu` is a direct dependency of `semio-framework-core`, so this single external file blocks the whole dependency chain. Confirmed via `git status` that this file is modified-but-uncommitted by a concurrent session (not part of this ticket's diff), and the exact broken lines persisted unchanged across all 5 retries. I did not fix it myself since it's outside this ticket's file ownership and another session appears to be mid-edit on it — instead flagged it as a separate background task (task_17c082e4) since it's blocking workspace-wide compilation, not just this ticket. All Rust changes were instead verified via thorough manual review (multiple full re-reads of the diffs, cross-checking every `HubStorage` trait method signature against its sqlite implementation, tracing every `PersistenceBinding::Hub`/`PresencePeer` construction site repo-wide). Recommend re-running `cargo check --workspace`, `cargo test -p os-hub`, `cargo test -p semio-framework-sync`, `cargo test -p semio-framework-core` once the ui_wgpu fix lands.
